# PrismXGPT

> PrismXGPT is a modern, premium ChatGPT-style AI assistant for chat, writing, code, research, and image generation. Free forever with an optional Premium plan.

PrismXGPT runs on a curated set of top-tier reasoning models, chosen automatically for each task. It supports multi-turn chat, image generation and editing, project workspaces, and shareable read-only conversations.
